common:synonyms.#text: steel wire; fine steel wire; miniature steel wire; ultrafine steel wire

common:generalComment.#text: Steel wire is an extremely useful and versatile material that can be found in many things you use everyday in the home, as well as in the car you drive. It is also useful in commercial, industrial and military applications—for cleaning, for spring-loaded devices, for reinforcing, for structural integrity, and even for making music. Steel wire is a metallic, cylindrical, and flexible strand that is commonly used to conduct electricity. It can form a wire rope which has even more uses in both private and public sector industries.
钢丝是一种非常有用且用途广泛的材料，在许多日常家居用品和汽车中都能找到它的身影。它还可用于商业、工业和军事领域--清洁、弹簧装置、加固、结构完整性，甚至用于制作音乐。钢丝是一种金属丝，呈圆柱形，有韧性，通常用于导电。它可以形成钢丝绳，在私营和公共行业中用途更广。

common:synonyms.#text: steel shot; steel grit; cast-steel shot

common:generalComment.#text: Cast steel shot is made from high-quality steel scrap, which is first melted, and then the molten steel is formed into small balls by high-pressure water jets. Steel shot and steel grit have appropriate hardness and good resilience. They can clean internal corners and workpieces with complex shapes evenly and quickly. Cast steel shot and steel grit both have lower carbon contents than high carbon steel shot, which typically has a carbon concentration of 0.8% to 1.2%. Cast-steel shot are available in a wide variety of sizes, from 0.18 to 2.4 mm.
铸钢丸是由高质量的钢铁废料制成的，首先将其熔化，然后通过高压水射流将熔融的钢铁形成小球。钢丸和钢砂具有适当的硬度和良好的弹性。它们可以快速均匀地清理内角和形状复杂的工件。铸钢丸和钢砂的碳含量都低于高碳钢丸，后者的碳浓度通常为0.8%至1.2%。铸钢丸有各种尺寸可供选择，从0.18到2.4毫米。
